name: remote-approval-complexity
goal: Remote approval validation meets the existing complexity limit while preserving exact projects and optional comment permissions.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Approved behavior-preserving Remote cleanup is documented in the model-list feature spec. The normal Remote lint currently reports approval complexity 13 against the unchanged limit 10.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing control-input cases lacked the full optional comment matrix and exact output shape, and 65 duplicate IDs did not isolate the count ceiling. Strengthened the standard cases with omitted/invalid comments and 64/65 distinct projects; all behavior must remain identical.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Test-only commit 6c9bccb58b4d482e3993d9e2971df7bc189fc42a produced immutable red record 492a14014c14eceecd60f72210326c9fd36fd820b12ceaf771540e4567035925. Normal lint rejects approval complexity 13 against limit 10; all four strengthened runtime cases pass. No product source is repaired yet.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Fix 0bf42a0f extracts the unchanged comment guard into its owning validator module, retaining field-read order, exact keys, count limits, project order, legacy omissions and error codes. The registered approval contract now describes those boundaries.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: The unchanged lint-plus-control-input command passes at 0bf42a0f in the same frozen environment and source snapshot process as red 492a14014c14eceecd60f72210326c9fd36fd820b12ceaf771540e4567035925. All four strengthened runtime cases pass and lint meets the unchanged complexity limit.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
